explanation: This model represents the growth of a collection of frimbulators over time. We start with an initial stock of frimbulators and experience a daily growth rate of 2%. This growth rate is applied to the current stock, resulting in an increase in the number of frimbulators each day.
title: Frimbulator Collection Growth Model

variables.documentation: The total number of frimbulators in the collection at any time.
variables.name: frimbulator_stock

variables.documentation: The daily increase in the number of frimbulators based on the growth rate applied to the current stock of frimbulators.
variables.name: growth_rate

variables.documentation: The flow representing the increase in frimbulators each day, calculated based on the growth rate and current stock of frimbulators.
variables.name: frimbulator_increase

variables.documentation: A variable representing the multiplier used to calculate daily increase in frimbulators.
variables.name: daily_multiplier
